paragraphs.text: The song opens with taking shelter: refuge in Shambhu, who abides in everything. A student comes spinning with questions, and the teacher answers — in verses. That question-and-answer is the frame holding everything that follows.

Then the world gets built in three quick strokes. First, the fourfold egg — everything that exists — is manifested by nothing but the weight of the Lords power; and the enjoyer who gets embodied inside it is Shiva Himself, in fetters. Second, the Lord holds every form the way a crystal takes on whatever color is put next to it; the self moves with the moving world-mass and rests with the resting one. Third, the everywhere-self shines inside the mirror of the mind; and when grace purifies that mind, it mirrors back a self made of light, complete with will, knowing, and acting.
